question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in simple future tense form.

I loved.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. I will love .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the** past tense** ("I loved").
 
• The question asks us to transform it into the **simple future tense**.
 
• The structure of the **simple future tense** is **Subject + will/shall + base verb**.
 
• Among the given options:
 
 
• **Option 1: "I will love"** – This is the correct transformation into simple future tense.
 
• **Option 2: "I had loved"** – This is in the past perfect tense.
 
• **Option 3: "I love"** – This is in the present tense.
 
• **Option 4: "I shall be loving"** – This is in the future continuous tense.
 
 

Correct sentence: *I will love*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Simple Future Tense:**

 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + will/shall + base verb.
 
• **Example:** She will travel to Paris next week.
 
• **Usage:** Describes actions that will happen in the future.
 
 
 
• **Future Continuous Tense:**
 
 
• **Structure:** Subject + will/shall + be + present participle (-ing form).
 
• **Example:** He will be studying at 8 PM.
 
• **Usage:** Refers to actions that will be ongoing at a specific time in the future.
